_comment: Spoken radio telephony -> ICAO airline designator, for radio_intel.
'Qantas four one two' becomes QFA412, which is exactly what that aircraft
broadcasts as its ADS-B ident - so the radio call can be pinned on a track.
Keys are matched as whole words, case-insensitively. Multi-word keys are fine.
special: emergency-service telephony -> ADS-B ident prefixes it may use
(empty list = match by spoken number against emergency-service tracks only).
